$comment: Canonical identity strings for each balance adapter family. These are the values to pass as constructor arguments (protocol, positionDetail, positionId) when deploying a new adapter instance. positionDetail is written as a partial JSON string — the deploy script appends the closing brace after adding chain-specific fields. positionId is typically the primary contract address the adapter reads from (e.g. dataProvider for Aave, comet for Compound, pool address for LP adapters). Exception: MorphoMarket derives positionId automatically from marketId and has no positionId constructor parameter.
$positionDetail_convention: protocol = bare protocol name (matches top-level protocol field). product = functional category (Lending, Staking, LP, Vault, Market, Rewards, Safety Module, Umbrella, Savings). name = human-readable instance label (market name, pool pair, vault name). Per-position fields (appended at emission time, not part of the constructor template): type = sub-classification that varies per emitted leg (e.g. Supply/Borrow/Collateral for lending, stkAAVE/stkABPT/stkABPTv2/stkGHO for Safety Module); token = per-leg token symbol for LP adapters (BalancerV3, Aura, Curve, Convex, PancakeSwapV3). The $perPositionFields key in each entry documents what the adapter appends at runtime.

ERC20DefaultAdapter.$comment: Hardcoded in Solidity to protocol='wallet'. Not configurable.

AaveV2InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Aave V2 instances. Thin subclass of AaveV3InstancesMeta (same DataProvider ABI; pool resolved via getLendingPool() instead of getPool()). Constructor takes (protocol, navCalculator). The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under AaveV2InstancesMeta.instances — instance ProtocolDataProvider addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = abi.encode(LendingPool, reserve); name = describePosition() => "<reserve symbol> position (<market id>)" (e.g. "USDC position (Aave genesis market)"); market id via LendingPool.getAddressesProvider().getMarketId(). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV2Instance adapter.
AaveV2InstancesMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Borrow | Collateral (up to 2 rows per reserve — variable debt only, stable debt not reported)

AaveV2Instance.$superseded: Superseded by AaveV2InstancesMeta (ADR 0010); per-instance deploys disabled in chain config.
AaveV2Instance.$deployedNote: Existing deployments used the dataProvider address as positionId. Canonical target is the Pool address.

AaveV3Instance.$superseded: Superseded by AaveV3InstancesMeta (ADR 0010); per-market deploys disabled in chain config.
AaveV3Instance.$deployedNote: Existing deployments used the dataProvider address as positionId. Canonical target is the Pool address.

AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Aave V3 instances. Constructor takes only (protocol, navCalculator). The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under AaveV3InstancesMeta.instances — each entry is the instance's ProtocolDataProvider address). Reserves within an instance are enumerated trustlessly via getAllReservesTokens(); reserve tokens are NOT separate coordinates. Identity derived on-chain: positionId = abi.encode(instance Pool via ADDRESSES_PROVIDER.getPool(), reserve); name = describePosition() => "<reserve symbol> position (<market id>)" (e.g. "USDC position (Aave V3 Lido Ethereum)"); market id via Pool.ADDRESSES_PROVIDER().getMarketId().
AaveV3InstancesMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Borrow | Collateral (up to 2 rows per reserve — same shape as AaveV3Instance).

AaveV3SafetyModule.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Reward (underlyingAsset distinguishes the stake token; stkAAVE has two AAVE legs told apart by type alone)

AaveUmbrella.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (underlyingAsset distinguishes the stake token)

SparkLend.$deployedNote: Existing deployments used the dataProvider address as positionId. Canonical target is the Pool address.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Compound V3 (Comet) markets. Constructor takes (compoundRewards, rewardToken, protocol, navCalculator) — CometRewards + COMP are chain-level constants. The active comet set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under CompoundV3CometsMeta.instances — comet addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = comet address; name = comet name(). Supersedes the per-comet CompoundV3Comet adapter. protocol is the canonical 'Compound V3' (not the legacy per-comet 'Compound v3').
CompoundV3CometsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Borrow | Collateral | Rewards (base supply/borrow + per-collateral + COMP)

CompoundV3Comet.$superseded: Superseded by CompoundV3CometsMeta (ADR 0010); per-comet mainnet deploys disabled in chain config.
CompoundV3Comet.$deployedNote: Existing mainnet deployments use protocol='Compound v3' (lowercase v). New deployments should use 'Compound V3' for consistency. Requires redeploy to fix.

MorphoVault.$superseded: Superseded by MorphoVaultsMeta (ADR 0010); per-vault deploys disabled in chain config.

MorphoVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Morpho ERC4626 vaults. Constructor takes only (protocol, navCalculator) — there are no per-vault constructor args. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (set via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under MorphoVaultsMeta.instances in the chain config). positionDetail and positionId are derived on-chain per instance: positionId = vault address as hex, name = vault.name().

ERC4626Wrap.$comment: Generic ERC-4626 unwrap balance adapter. Constructor checks the wrapper's `asset()` is NAV-registered (reverts otherwise). Reports `convertToAssets(balanceOf(account))` denominated in the underlying. Used for Aave V3 stata-tokens (waEth*), the Aave sGHO savings vault, and any other thin ERC-4626 wrapper where the share price is derivable purely from convertToAssets. Constructor is (wrapper, navCalculator); identity is emitted on-chain (protocolId = ERC4626, positionKind = Supplied, positionId = abi.encode(wrapper)). Of the per-instance chain-config fields, only `wrapper` is read by the deploy scripts; the protocol/positionDetail/positionId strings are legacy reference metadata.

MorphoMarket.$superseded: Superseded by MorphoMarketsMeta (ADR 0010); per-market deploys disabled in chain config.
MorphoMarket.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Borrow | Collateral. getAdapterPositions emits gross — Supply and Borrow on the loan token are separate rows when both supplyShares > 0 and borrowShares > 0 (up to 3 rows per call: Collateral + Supply + Borrow). The simple getters getAdapterBalanceForAsset / getAdapterBalances still net the loan token.
MorphoMarket.$positionIdNote: positionId is derived automatically from marketId (Strings.toHexString(uint256(marketId), 32)) — not a constructor parameter.

MorphoMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Morpho Blue markets. Constructor takes (morpho, protocol, navCalculator). The active marketId set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under MorphoMarketsMeta.instancesRaw — raw bytes32 marketIds, NOT addresses). Identity is derived on-chain: positionId = marketId hex (Strings.toHexString(uint256(marketId), 32)); name = collateralSymbol/loanSymbol read from the tokens.
MorphoMarketsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Borrow | Collateral (up to 3 gross rows per market — same shape as MorphoMarket).

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity of ALL Balancer V3 pools. Constructor takes only (protocol, navCalculator). The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under BalancerV3PoolsMeta.instances — each entry is the pool/BPT address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address hex; name = BPT token name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3 adapter's Supply legs.
BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per underlying pool token; wallet BPT share only)

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the gauge-staked LP + BAL/extra rewards of ALL Balancer V3 gauges. Constructor takes (balancerMinter, protocol, navCalculator). The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under BalancerV3GaugesMeta.instances — each entry is the gauge address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = gauge address hex; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3 adapter's Staking + rewards legs.
BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (Staking=one leg per underlying pool token from staked BPT share; Rewards=one leg per reward token, BAL via the minter + extra gauge reward tokens)

BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity of ALL Balancer V2 pools. Constructor takes (vault, protocol, navCalculator). The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstancesRaw, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under BalancerV2PoolsMeta.instancesRaw — each entry is the raw 32-byte poolId, NOT an address; the BPT address is its top 160 bits). Composable-stable BPT-in-pool token excluded; supply via getActualSupply() when present else totalSupply(). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = BPT address hex; name = BPT token name().
BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per underlying pool token; wallet BPT share only)

BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the gauge-staked LP + BAL/extra rewards of ALL Balancer V2 gauges. Constructor takes (vault, balancerMinter, protocol, navCalculator). The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under BalancerV2GaugesMeta.instances — each entry is the gauge address). The BPT is read on-chain via gauge.lp_token() and its poolId via getPoolId(). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = gauge address hex; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). BAL inflation math identical to BalancerV3GaugesMeta.
BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (Staking=one leg per underlying pool token from staked BPT share; Rewards=one leg per reward token, BAL via the minter + extra gauge reward tokens)

BalancerV3.$superseded: Superseded by BalancerV3PoolsMeta (Supply legs) + BalancerV3GaugesMeta (Staking + Rewards legs) per ADR 0010. Retained for historical reference; per-pool deploys are disabled in chain config.
BalancerV3.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Staking (Supply=wallet LP, Staking=gauge-staked LP + gauge rewards; one pair per underlying pool token)

AuraRewardsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the staked BPT + BAL/AURA/extra rewards of ALL Aura pools. Constructor takes (booster, balancerV2Vault, protocol, navCalculator); AURA is resolved dynamically via Booster.minter() — do NOT pass an auraToken arg. The active rewarder set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under AuraRewardsMeta.instances — each entry is the Aura BaseRewardPool/rewarder address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = rewarder address hex. Supersedes the per-pool Aura adapter.
AuraRewardsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (Staking=one leg per underlying pool token from the staked BPT share, decomposed via the Balancer V2 Vault; Rewards=BAL via the cliff schedule + AURA via the mint rate + extra reward tokens)

CurvePoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the wallet-held (unstaked) LP of ALL Curve pools. Constructor takes only (protocol, navCalculator). The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under CurvePoolsMeta.instances — each entry is the pool/LP-token address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address hex. Supersedes the per-pool Curve adapter's Supply legs.
CurvePoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per underlying pool token; wallet LP share only)

CurveGaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the gauge-staked LP + CRV/extra rewards of ALL Curve gauges. Constructor takes (minter, crvToken, protocol, navCalculator); pass minter=address(0) on L2 / RewardsOnlyGauges (no CRV via the Minter). The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under CurveGaugesMeta.instances — each entry is the gauge address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = gauge address hex. Supersedes the per-pool Curve adapter's Staking + rewards legs.
CurveGaugesMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (Staking=one leg per underlying pool token from the staked LP share; Rewards=CRV claimable lower-bound via the Minter + extra gauge reward tokens)

ConvexRewardsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for the staked LP + CRV/CVX/extra rewards of ALL Convex rewarders. Constructor takes (booster, cvxToken, protocol, navCalculator); the LP is resolved via booster.poolInfo(pid()). The active rewarder set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under ConvexRewardsMeta.instances — each entry is the Convex BaseRewardPool/rewarder address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = rewarder address hex. Supersedes the per-pool Convex adapter.
ConvexRewardsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Rewards (Staking=one leg per underlying pool token from the staked LP share; Rewards=CRV via earned() + CVX via the cliff schedule + extra reward tokens, unwrapping stash tokens)

Aura.$superseded: Superseded by AuraRewardsMeta (ADR 0010); per-pool deploys disabled in chain config.
Aura.$perPositionFields: type: Staking (one position per underlying asset)

Curve.$superseded: Superseded by CurvePoolsMeta (Supply legs) + CurveGaugesMeta (Staking + Rewards legs) per ADR 0010; per-pool deploys disabled in chain config.
Curve.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Staking (Supply=wallet LP, Staking=gauge-staked LP + CRV/extra rewards; one pair per underlying pool token)

Convex.$superseded: Superseded by ConvexRewardsMeta (ADR 0010); per-pool deploys disabled in chain config.
Convex.$perPositionFields: type: Staking (one position per underlying asset)

FluidFTokensMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Fluid fTokens (ERC4626 lending vaults). Constructor takes (protocol, navCalculator). The active fToken set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under FluidFTokensMeta.instances — fToken addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = fToken address; name = fToken symbol(). Supersedes the per-fToken FluidFToken adapter.
FluidFTokensMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per fToken in its underlying)

FluidVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Fluid T1 vaults. Constructor takes (vaultResolver, protocol, navCalculator) — VaultResolver is the chain-level constant. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under FluidVaultsMeta.instances — T1 vault addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = collSym/debtSym. Supersedes the per-vault FluidVault adapter. T1 vaults only.
FluidVaultsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Collateral | Borrow (supply + debt aggregated over the account's NFT positions)

FluidFToken.$superseded: Superseded by FluidFTokensMeta (ADR 0010); per-fToken mainnet deploys disabled in chain config.

FluidVault.$superseded: Superseded by FluidVaultsMeta (ADR 0010); per-vault mainnet deploys disabled in chain config.

GearboxMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Gearbox V3 ERC4626 farming pools. Constructor takes (protocol, navCalculator). The active market set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under GearboxMarketsMeta.instances — market addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = market address; name = market name(). Supersedes the per-market GearboxMarket adapter.
GearboxMarketsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per market in its underlying)

GearboxMarket.$superseded: Superseded by GearboxMarketsMeta (ADR 0010); per-market deploys disabled in chain config.

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL StakeWise V3 vaults. Constructor takes (underlyingToken, protocol, navCalculator) — underlyingToken is the chain-level staking asset (ETH sentinel on mainnet, GNO on Gnosis). The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.instances — vault addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name(). Supersedes the per-vault StakeWiseV3Vault adapter.
StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Borrow (Staking=vault shares→assets, isDebt=false; Borrow=osToken debt→assets, isDebt=true)

StakeWiseV3Vault.$superseded: Superseded by StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta (ADR 0010); per-vault deploys disabled in chain config.
StakeWiseV3Vault.$perPositionFields: type: Staking | Borrow (Staking=vault shares converted to assets, isDebt=false; Borrow=osToken debt converted to assets, isDebt=true)

KelpWithdrawalQueue.$perPositionFields: type: Staking; one position per NAV-registered payout asset (stETH, ETHx, native ETH) discovered at runtime

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Uniswap V3 pools. Constructor takes (positionManager, protocol, navCalculator). The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters under UniswapV3PoolsMeta.instances — pool addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address; name = sym0/sym1 feeTier (e.g. WBTC/WETH 0.3%). Supersedes the per-pool UniswapV3Pool adapter.
UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Fees (up to 4 legs: token0/token1 liquidity + token0/token1 fees)

UniswapV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable contract for ALL Uniswap V2 pairs (also serves PancakeSwap V2 via the PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta thin subclass / a separate deployment with protocol set accordingly). Constructor takes (protocol, navCalculator). The active pair set lives on NAVCalculator (instances — pair addresses). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pair address; name = sym0/sym1 LP. Supersedes the per-pair UniswapV2 adapter.
UniswapV2PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per pool token)

PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): subclass of UniswapV3PoolsMeta overriding the slot0 read (uint32 feeProtocol). Constructor takes (positionManager, protocol, navCalculator). Pool set on NAVCalculator (instances).
PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Fees. Inherits UniswapV3PoolsMeta behaviour.

PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): thin subclass of UniswapV2PoolsMeta. Constructor takes (protocol, navCalculator). Pair set on NAVCalculator (instances).
PancakeSwapV2PoolsMeta.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one leg per pool token). Inherits UniswapV2PoolsMeta behaviour.

UniswapV3Pool.$superseded: Superseded by UniswapV3PoolsMeta (ADR 0010); per-pool deploys disabled in chain config.

UniswapV2.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one position per pool token)

PancakeSwapV3Pool.$perPositionFields: type: Supply | Fees. Inherits UniswapV3Pool behaviour.

PancakeSwapV2.$perPositionFields: type: Supply (one position per pool token). Inherits UniswapV2 behaviour.
